name: Lane Bose
home: the western blocks near Ferry Street Rooms
life: “I still remember posting a letter just before the afternoon pickup.” On Friday, near the downtown fountain, Lane keeps a little time free to hear who is playing at the far end of the park.
voice: I posted it because the author never took chances. I'm learning the difference between a chance and a choice.
appearance: Lane is easy to recognize by a loose dark braid and a broad nose and a deep dimple on one cheek. Usually dressed in a mustard canvas overshirt with a pocket notebook shaped by years of sitting on it, Lane presses the lips together to keep a smile in when listening.
personality: Lane has a quick wit and an equally quick sense of shame. A joke is often Lane's way of finding out whether a room is friendly enough for a serious question.
agenda: To return control of the submission to the writer.
family: Grey Garza is Lane’s stepsibling. Lane gets to change the plan. Grey offers the first invitation. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *The widow's dividend*, Grey says, “I forecast a loss and delayed moving home. One unexpected payment could bring my wife back to the coast.”
connections: Sadie Cross (author). The person who entered the work has to put the decision back in the author's hands.

reactions.situation: A relative wants the manuscript returned unopened
reactions.response: Lane returns the pages privately without treating keeping them closed as a verdict on the work.
reactions.asWritten: A relative wants the manuscript returned unopened. Lane returns the pages privately without treating keeping them closed as a verdict on the work.

reactions.situation: The last bus leaves while an elderly stranger is still crossing toward it
reactions.response: Lane offers to walk to the next staffed place together, at the stranger's pace, to ask about another ride.

reactions.response: Lane seeks out the person it hurt before telling anybody why it was supposed to be funny.
reactions.asWritten: If the joke lands badly, Lane seeks out the person it hurt before telling anybody why it was supposed to be funny.
